snippet.title: Avaryn | Official Trailer | Tower Defense MMORPG
snippet.description:
The official trailer: four races, one shared continent, and the towers you build beside your friends.

Avaryn is a Tower Defense MMORPG played in your browser. Pick a race and a class, quest with friends, and when the enemy marches, build towers and fight beside them.

Play: https://playavaryn.com
Founder packs: https://playavaryn.com/shop
Wiki: https://wiki.playavaryn.com
Discord: https://discord.gg/6RsHb8j9kn
